text:
maria: Heads up — Snyk just flagged CVE-2026-XXXX for net/http (header parsing edgecase). Affects go 1.19-1.21 builds we still have in a few services.

alex: link?

maria: https://snyk.io/vuln/CVE-2026-XXXX (short) — gist: malformed headers can lead to request smuggling in particular proxy paths. Not a remote RCE but can bypass auth for some internal endpoints.

liam: Oof. Which services are on the old runtime?

maria: staging infer-worker, metrics-proxy, and one old test harness in infra-runner. production fleet mostly on 1.22 but some Dedicated edge nodes still pinned to older go images in k8s.

alex: We also have a grpc dependency update queued — grpc v1.50 has fixes for stream reset handling. Might be a combo risk with net/http.

maria: Agreed. Proposal: 1) urgent go.mod pin and patch for services still on 1.19–1.21, 2) apply grpc patch where used, 3) canary rollout for the two infra services, 4) add request-level audit logs for the affected endpoints while we patch.

dina: For pinning: do we want to use a replace directive or force a minor upgrade? I prefer explicit minor upgrade to 1.22.5 (the patched go1.22 build) so CI exercises the new stdlib. replace can hide things.

alex: +1 to upgrade to go1.22.5. For grpc/jwt libs we should move to grpc v1.50.3 and golang-jwt v4.0.1 (the patched release). I can open PRs.

maria: Can we timeline this? Which services are P0?

liam: P0: metrics-proxy (ingresses), infra-runner (internal CI agent). P1: staging infer-worker. P0 needs hotpatch this week.

alex: I'll open two PRs: metrics-proxy and infra-runner with go.mod updates. Will include CI that runs short smoke and integration tests. PRs will include a small test harness that verifies header-parsing behavior:
```
// tests/header_smuggle_test.go
req := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/", nil)
req.Header.Set("X-Forwarded-For", "1.2.3.4\r\nHost:evil")
// assert we get 400 / sanitized header
```

maria: Nice. Also enable audit logging (request id + auth decision) for these routes for 30 days so we can search for suspicious requests. Can ops add a short retention policy?

liam: I'll add a separate PR to enable audit events to the ELK ingest with a 30d retention tag. We won't ship payloads, just metadata (path, ip, result).

dina: For Dedicated customers: do we need to coordinate a private deployment patch? Some customers have pinned images. Ops: we should prepare rollback notes for them.

maria: Good point. I'll draft an email to account managers with a short KB: explanation, risk, recommended action (upgrade to go1.22.5 + grpc v1.50.3), and rollback steps.

alex: Estimated work: patches + tests ~3 engineer-days, canary rollout 1 day, audit logging + retention 0.5 day, customer comms 0.5 day.

maria: Can we push hotpatch for metrics-proxy today with emergency flag? If CI green we can roll to canary in 2 hours.

alex: Starting the metrics-proxy PR now. tagging @dina for the Dedicated KB and @liam for audit ingest config.

liam: I patched ELK mapping to accept audit-event.v1 and added short dashboard. will ship once PRs merged.

maria: Also: dependabot found an oauth/jwt transitive lib that needs minor bump. Not critical for exploit chain but we should include in the same rollout. Saves churn.

alex: I'll include the jwt upgrade in the same PRs where present. We should avoid multiple separate deploys to reduce blowups.

maria: Security triage: severity = high (auth bypass potential), exploitability = low to medium, impact = moderate internal exposure. Action = immediate patch + canary + audit.

dina: Documenting the pin strategy: we move to minimal supported go1.22.5, add a go.mod comment with CVE link and date, and schedule quarterly dependency sweeps.

alex: PRs: 1862346800 (metrics-proxy), 1862346850 (infra-runner). I'll post links in the thread when created.

maria: Thanks. After canary, run a quick blackbox scan (snyk + internal fuzzer) against canary endpoints. If all good, promote to prod. Keep this thread for audit notes.

dependabot: bump golang.org/x/net from v0.0.0-202106xx to v0.0.0-20240xxx (automated).

maria: noted. I'll consolidate later. Closing the triage meeting — everyone with action items pls update the PR and add "SEC: CVE-2026-XXXX" to commit titles.

alex: will do. :thumbsup:

liam: I'll monitor logs during canary window and alert on any auth anomalies.

maria: Great. End.
